items.title: Establish the protected daily-lock control plane
acceptance: The strict TypeScript build and deterministic tests must pass.
The 0.5 percent objective must scale from the usable pot.
Operator and model authority tokens must remain separate.
Entry sizing must be stop-defined.
Protected entry and partial re-arm must be durable.
UUID replay, conflict detection, and restart durability must be proven.
The paired Hermes profile contract must exist.
evidence: Gateway foundation merged on main at 9523969756d451ddc371a5d542498dadafd325ee.
Paired profile foundation merged on main at 9d465211369cee1eb8d8cbfa4023948ab6bba63e.
The smoke evidence used 1,000 USD equity, a 5 USD objective, a 450 USD protected entry, 4.95 USD planned loss, an 8.54 USD net target outcome, and a 1,005 USD active protected-equity floor.
Strict build and deterministic control-plane tests passed before merge.
items.notes: This item establishes control-plane correctness, not venue or profitability acceptance.

items.title: Accept the first production venue adapter
acceptance: The official capability contract must be recorded.
Read-only endpoint authority must be explicit and fail closed.
Credentials and signatures must not enter retained evidence.
Authenticated fee and precision discovery must be implemented and evidenced.
Public order-book continuity must be replay-proven.
Private account and order state plus restart reconciliation must be replay-proven.
Continuous public and private transport evidence must be captured.
Native protected entry and exact order ownership must be accepted.
Ambiguous transport and restart recovery must be accepted.
evidence: Binance USD-M shadow discovery and supervised public/private stream code are on main.
Futures Testnet run 32788614491 recorded 111 public messages, one snapshot, zero reconnects, zero stream errors, contiguous sequence, and a ready non-crossed replay.
The USD-M order book now accepts snapshot overlap and enforces pu equal to the previous u after synchronization.
The observed public fixture is frozen at tests/fixtures/binance-usdm/observed-testnet-public.jsonl with canonical evidence SHA-256 0b1053f5607bfc9354e4744f993f42637dada8902b5982f69319c5b279dd2ab7.
Windows strict build and 34 of 34 deterministic tests passed after the direct-main public-evidence integration.

Commit 5a784f6 implements a dormant Testnet/loopback-only protected mutation kernel with deterministic native identities, evidence-before-mutation, exact-query reconciliation, stop-before-target proof, and exact-quantity emergency flattening.
Windows strict build and 47 of 47 deterministic tests passed for the protected mutation contract, including partial-entry flattening and GET-only restart reconstruction.

Commit 0b5b41b implements an authenticated GET-only Testnet preflight that fails closed on production, missing credentials, unsafe account configuration, existing exposure/orders, and malformed private snapshots.
Windows strict build and 53 of 53 deterministic tests passed after the Testnet preflight source increment.
GitHub issue #5 records the source evidence while retaining authenticated Testnet preflight execution and bounded mutation acceptance as open gates.
The 2026-08-24 Binance WebSocket migration was applied: constructed depth, regular-market, and user-data sockets now use the official /public, /market, and /private routes.

A bounded credential-free Futures Testnet probe observed live BTCUSDT depthUpdate and markPriceUpdate events on the routed public and market endpoints; authenticated private routing remains unobserved.
Windows strict build and 55 of 55 deterministic tests passed after route construction and route assertions were added.

Commit a36fabe adds a separate credential-free raw-market recorder for BTCUSDT aggregate trades and 1-second mark price with strict identity inspection, bounded JSONL retention, finite capture, and content-addressed verification.

The retained 15.016-second production-public fixture contains 245 aggregate trades and 12 mark-price updates in one contiguous lifecycle with zero errors, backoffs, invalid messages, non-increasing trade IDs, or non-monotonic per-family event times; canonical SHA-256 07185347c6e1f6bdc0f2900b026f49d753d41c6de573904e4c7d8315669eb48c.
Windows strict build and 60 of 60 deterministic tests passed after freezing the raw-market fixture.

Commit 6e1f7e3 adds a finite Futures-Testnet-only authenticated private evidence gate: preflight before listen-key creation, bounded local capture, complete private lifecycle and reconciliation requirements, fully applied user events, deterministic replay, and a content-addressed manifest without raw account values.
The private evidence command rejects missing credentials before transport; no Binance credential or endpoint environment variables were present for an external run.
Windows strict build and 63 of 63 deterministic tests passed for the dormant private evidence gate.
items.stop_line: Do not use production credentials, submit a venue mutation, deploy, or claim production acceptance without explicit human authorization and the remaining evidence gates.
items.notes: Binance USD-M public Futures Testnet transport and replay are accepted as a sub-gate. Protected mutation and authenticated preflight are implemented only as dormant deterministic source. No Testnet credentials were present in the delivery environment. Authenticated private evidence, observed Testnet mutations, engine integration, native fill/protection acceptance, mainnet eligibility, and production selection remain pending.

items.title: Build event replay and calibrated opportunity baselines
acceptance: Event-time replay must include costs, latency, nonfills, and partial fills.
Fill and target-before-stop models must be calibrated.
Frozen holdout and shadow baselines must exist.
items.blocked_reason: GC-002 is not done; authenticated venue and execution evidence are prerequisites for factual replay semantics.
items.notes: Do not attribute profitability to an LLM before numerical and no-trade baselines exist.

items.title: Run shadow A/B and a bounded real-money canary
acceptance: The hybrid policy must be compared with the numerical-only baseline.
Any mutation smoke test must use explicitly approved bounded disposable capital.
Protected live outcomes must reconcile fees and slippage.
Promotion must remain reversible.
items.stop_line: Real credentials, venue mutation, live capital, and production promotion require explicit human approval at the time of action.
items.blocked_reason: GC-002 and GC-003 are not done, and the paired Hermes candidate and position workers are not accepted.
items.notes: Tests and architecture do not imply that this item is safe to begin.
